title: Build your career where communication meets craft.
subtitle: At L+H, you'll work on real projects for real clients – in a team that prefers direct communication over buzzwords. Grow your skills, your responsibility, and your impact step by step.

why_work.title: A career path with real faces, not just org charts.
why_work.subtitle: We work closely with our clients – and just as closely with each other. Expect clear responsibilities, visible impact, and colleagues who actually know your name.

cards.title: Varied client projects
cards.content: From concept to execution – you'll see ideas turn into tangible communication.

cards.title: A well-tuned team
cards.content: You'll be part of a small, experienced team that values direct communication and trust.

cards.title: Room to contribute
cards.content: Bring your strengths and shape your role over time – rather than fitting into a rigid template.

jobs.title: Open positions – when the timing is right.
jobs.subtitle: We publish our open positions here. Get in touch if you're interested in one of the roles. If there's currently no matching role, we're still happy to receive speculative applications via our contact page.
jobs.no_positions: No open positions at the moment.
jobs.no_positions_helper: Sometimes the best matches happen without a job posting. If you feel like you and L+H would be a good fit, we'd love to hear from you via a speculative application on our contact page.

how_we_hire.title: Transparent, personal, and to the point.
how_we_hire.subtitle: We keep our process lean and personal. No endless assessment marathons – just a few focused steps in which we find out whether we're a good fit for each other.

cards.name: Step 01
cards.title: Your message
cards.content: You contact us via the contact form and briefly outline who you are, your background, and what you're looking for.

cards.name: Step 02
cards.title: Initial conversation
cards.content: We schedule a short call to clarify both sides' expectations and see whether there's a potential match.

cards.name: Step 03
cards.title: Deeper dive
cards.content: If things look promising, we talk in more detail about your experience and way of working, and may look at a small work sample.

cards.name: Step 04
cards.title: Decision & next steps
cards.content: You'll get honest feedback and – ideally – a concrete offer for how you can join us.

career.title: Not just a job, but a path you help shape.
career.subtitle: We see career growth as something we build together. We talk regularly about where you want to go and what you need to get there – instead of sending you annual feedback forms.

cards.title: Onboarding & mentoring
cards.content: You'll get structured onboarding and a dedicated point of contact who introduces you to our clients, tools, and processes.

cards.title: Growing responsibility
cards.content: Over time you'll take on more ownership: your own projects, direct client contact, or responsibility for specific topics.

cards.title: Long-term development
cards.content: Whether you lean toward concept work, project management, or digital topics – we shape your role together with you.
